hassio_confirm.title: Notification API add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to configure Home Assistant to connect to the Notification API provided by the add-on: {addon}?

user.title: Connect to the Notification API add-on
user.description: Use this if the add-on was not discovered automatically. The values are shown on the add-on's Integration page.

data_description.host: The add-on's hostname on the Supervisor network, for example local-notification-api.
data_description.port: The add-on's API port. The default is 8080.
data_description.token: The API token shown on the add-on's Integration page.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the Notification API add-on
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on at {host}:{port} rejected the stored API token. Enter the current token from the add-on's Integration page. Restarting Home Assistant while the add-on is running also re-delivers the token through discovery.

data_description.token: The API token shown on the add-on's Integration page.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the add-on. Check that it is running and that the host and port are correct.
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: The Notification API is already configured.
abort.discovery_invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the token it published through discovery. Restart the add-on, or set the integration up manually with the token from the add-on's Integration page.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The add-on sent incomplete discovery information.

auth_failed.message: The Notification API add-on rejected the API token.

update_failed.message: Could not reach the Notification API add-on: {error}

recipients_unsupported.message: The Notification API add-on doesn't support the recipients list yet. Update the add-on.

webhook_register_failed.message: Could not register the webhook with the Notification API add-on: {error}

not_loaded.message: The Notification API integration isn't loaded. Check that it is set up and that the add-on is running.

unknown_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a notify entity of the Notification API integration.

send_invalid.message: The Notification API add-on rejected the notification: {errors}

send_no_deliveries.message: No recipient has a channel to deliver on. Check the recipients' verified channels and routing in the add-on, or the channels override.

send_unsupported.message: The Notification API add-on doesn't support sending yet. Update the add-on.

addon_unreachable.message: The Notification API add-on is unreachable: {error}

send_failed.message: The Notification API add-on couldn't send the notification: {error}

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Sends a notification to contacts and groups through the Notification API add-on. The add-on picks the channels from each contact's routing for the priority.

to.name: To
to.description: Recipient handles, such as contact:alice or group:family, or notify entities of this integration, such as notify.notification_api_contact_alice.

title.name: Title
title.description: An optional title. Telegram shows it in bold, SMS puts it before the message.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: How urgent the notification is. The add-on maps it to channels for each contact.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Override the add-on's channel choice. Leave empty to use each contact's routing.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: An optional label, logged by the add-on and included in delivery events.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the original response and sends nothing new.
